# Zoth Civilization v3.0 — Full Grounding Corpus (`llms-full.txt`)
Canonical URL: https://zoth-civilization.netlify.app/llms-full.txt

## 1. Architecture & Gameplay Overview
Zoth Civilization v3.0 (`https://zoth-civilization.netlify.app`) is an interactive autonomous society simulation engineered by `1nc0gn30` (`@1nc0gn30`) on the **NullAI Platform** (`https://nullai.tech`). It runs seamlessly in two modes:
1. **Zero-Config In-Browser Client Engine (`ZothClientSim`)**: Runs 100% client-side on static HTTPS (`https://zoth-civilization.netlify.app`) at 60 FPS with frustum-culled canvas rendering, 23 Pantheon Agents, 15 civic landmarks, 22 Hermetic Sanctuary Keys, 5 Imperator Quests (Ranks I–V), and 4 Planetary Decrees.
2. **Full BYOK / Local Sovereign Mode**: Visitors can click the polite AI Status pill (`AI Keys`) to connect **DeepSeek Flash (`deepseek-v4-flash-0731`) through Hermes Agent by Nous Research** (recommended lightweight & ultra-low-cost path), OpenRouter, or a local zero-egress Ollama endpoint (`http://127.0.0.1:11434`).

## 2. Strict Zero-Leak Privacy Architecture
- Personal gameplay logs, trajectories, mind journals, and generated meditation images are **strictly excluded** from the repository and public website.
- Custom meditations created in `/gallery.html` are saved exclusively to the visitor's own browser `localStorage` and can be exported or cleared anytime with one click.
